Question: top 10 Playlist with most number of tracks
Query: select b.Name, count(*) as TrackCount from PlaylistTrack a join Playlist b on a.PlaylistId =b.PlaylistId group by b.PlaylistId, b.Name order by TrackCount DESC LIMIT 10

Question: top 50 Invoice value with track count along with the customer name details
Query:
SELECT a.InvoiceId, d.FirstName, d.LastName, a.Total, Count(*) as NumberOfTracks FROM Invoice a join InvoiceLine b on a.InvoiceId=b.InvoiceId join Track c on c.TrackId=b.TrackId 
	join Customer d on a.CustomerId=d.CustomerId group by a.InvoiceId, d.FirstName, d.LastName, a.Total order by a.Total desc limit 50
